Waver

UI component that applies wave-like oscillation effects to UI elements.

Component UI

Schema

JSON
{
  "waver": {}
}

Description

The Waver component applies wave-like oscillation effects to UI elements. It creates sinusoidal motion patterns that add visual polish and attention-drawing animation to interface components.

Fields

FieldTypeDescription
Wave parameters are configured through UI properties.

Example

JSON
{
  "waver": {}
}
